articles.title: To Infinity and Beyond: Toy Story 5 Makes Box Office History with Third Straight Billion-Dollar Hit
articles.summary: Pixar's Toy Story 5 just crossed $1 billion globally, making it the only animated franchise ever to have three consecutive films hit that milestone. It's now 2026's top movie, edging out The Super Mario Galaxy Movie.

articles.title: Undercover Deadpool: Ryan Reynolds Roams Comic-Con Incognito, Takes Selfies with Unsuspecting Fans
articles.summary: Ryan Reynolds ditched the red suit for a gray denim Deadpool costume and wandered the Comic-Con floor with no handlers or security, surprising fans who thought he was just a cosplayer. He called the experience a 'gift' and later crashed Marvel's panel.

articles.title: Buried Treasure: America's 250th Birthday Time Capsule Will Wait 250 Years to Be Opened
articles.summary: A time capsule filled with items from all 50 states — including a diamond, a whale bone, and an AI prediction — will be buried in Philadelphia on July 4, 2026. It's engineered to survive 250 years underground and will be opened in 2276.
